{
  "subtype": "exploratory_data_analysis",
  "focus_variable": "resolution_time",
  "per_column": [
    {
      "name": "assigned_technician",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "Individual technician identity is an associational variable that could relate to resolution time, but with many distinct high-cardinality names it forms fine-grained categories that are hard to compare cleanly; overlaps with existing assigned_to. Marginally useful but not well-separated segmentation."
    },
    {
      "name": "primary_issue_domain",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Well-separated interpretable categories (connectivity, email, database, etc.) that can be grouped and compared against resolution time; a strong EDA segmentation axis, though somewhat correlated with category."
    },
    {
      "name": "incident_closure_status",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Open/closed status largely restates the existing 'state' field and is intertwined with whether resolution_time is even defined; not an external explanatory variable for how long resolution takes."
    },
    {
      "name": "issue_complexity_signal",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable, well-separated buckets (infrastructure_systemic, application_focused, user_access, endpoint_device) that plausibly associate with resolution time and support meaningful segmentation."
    },
    {
      "name": "issue_severity_signal",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Severity levels (outage_complete, partial_access, performance_degradation) are interpretable categories strongly associable with resolution time; good EDA axis, partially overlapping with priority."
    },
    {
      "name": "same_person_closure_flag",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "A clean binary flag (opener==closer) that can be compared against resolution time and reflects a workflow characteristic; interpretable segmentation with reasonable balance."
    },
    {
      "name": "caller_frequency_indicator",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Ordinal, well-separated caller-frequency bands offer an external behavioral dimension to segment resolution time by; interpretable and balanced."
    }
  ],
  "n_predictors": 6,
  "relationship_informativeness": 0.72,
  "rationale": "Most added columns are external, interpretable, well-separated categorical segmentations (issue domain, complexity, severity, caller frequency, same-person closure flag) that let a human explorer group and compare resolution_time along meaningful dimensions. Weaknesses: incident_closure_status essentially restates the existing state and conditions whether resolution_time exists, and assigned_technician is high-cardinality and duplicative of assigned_to. Some signals overlap with existing category/priority axes, but as a set they open genuine informative relationships around the focus, warranting a fairly strong but not top score."
}
